description: Book tattoo sessions at Fresh Ink, an appointment-only custom linework studio in Saint Paul, MN. Includes the booking MCP server and REST API as agent skills.
name: fresh-ink-booking

skills.description: Studio name, address, hours, session times, booking flow. MCP: get_studio_info. REST: GET /api/public/studio.
skills.name: get-studio-info

skills.description: Open appointment times between two dates (max 31 days). MCP: list_open_times. REST: GET /api/public/availability?from=&to=.
skills.name: list-open-times

skills.description: Hold an open time for 15 minutes; returns a checkout_url the user opens to lock in (free in proof of concept). MCP: hold_slot. REST: POST /api/public/holds (idempotent via Idempotency-Key).
skills.name: hold-slot

skills.description: Booking status: pending, confirmed, expired, cancelled. MCP: get_booking_status. REST: GET /api/public/bookings/{id}.
skills.name: get-booking-status
